description: This file contains utility functions related to a text user interface (TUI) for submitting commands, handling paste fallback on Windows Git Bash, and creating a burst coalescer for submitting messages efficiently.

methods.name: createEditorSubmitHandler
methods.description: Creates a handler function for submitting text input, managing command parsing, history, and special line handling.

methods.name: shouldEnableWindowsGitBashPasteFallback
methods.description: Determines if Windows Git Bash paste fallback should be enabled based on platform and environment variables.

methods.name: createSubmitBurstCoalescer
methods.description: Creates a coalescing function to batch rapid submit calls within a specified time window.
